shorts_extract.hook: Why saying 'I am calm' spikes panic while silently using your own first name cools anxiety in 1 second.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Kross (2014) Trier Social Stress Test 5-minute speech + Moser & Kross (2017) ERP/fMRI.
shorts_extract.twist: Using your own name drops amygdala & self-chatter reactivity in 1 second without burning effortful willpower.
